package rulefixtures

// scenario for malformed_struct_tag: Struct field tags that do not parse as valid Go tag key/value pairs.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: consistency; severity: contextual.

type AppConfig struct {
	Host     string `json:"host" xml:id`
	Port     int    `json:port`
	Database string `"json:database"`
	Debug    bool   `json:"debug" xml:"debug" db`
}

type RequestMeta struct {
	TraceID string `json:trace_id`
	UserID  int    `json:"user_id" :db`
}
